# EU AI Operator’s Desk

Canonical repository: https://github.com/angellllkr-eng/eu-ai-operator-desk

## Purpose

Evidence-led qualification and deployment guidance for European AI adopters.

## Core surfaces

- `/` — public qualification surface
- `/strategy` — Strategic Atlas
- `/hardware` — Private Compute Configurator
- `/about` — mission and contribution model

## Primary jobs

1. AI opportunity qualification
2. EU market and sector research
3. AI Act readiness questions and evidence mapping
4. Private compute design
5. Commercial qualification
6. Structured operator handoff

## Operating model

Discover → Qualify → Design → Approve → Execute → Record

## Platform relationship

The Desk is the research/qualification layer. MindReply/MRdash is the intended execution/control layer. Supabase/Postgres is the candidate operational system of record. Stripe is the candidate commercial layer. Links Connect and Soluvery are optional operational connectors.

## Machine payments

MPP is the preferred machine-payment interface; x402 is supported for compatibility. Paid resources are exposed behind HTTP 402 challenges and are intended to remain behind owner policy, budgets, verification, receipts, and audit logging. Test-stage endpoints are implemented in `cloudflare/payments/` and target Base Sepolia until explicitly promoted.

## Evidence policy

Every material claim should carry provenance and one of: VERIFIED, DIRECTIONAL, UNVERIFIED, BLOCKED.

## Safety boundary

The public Desk must not contain provider API secrets or autonomously trigger irreversible paid actions. External execution requires an explicit owner policy/approval path.

## Current state

Product launch changes are merged to `master`. GitHub Pages has a canonical deployment workflow targeting `master` and the actual Vite output directory `dist/public`. Cloudflare MPP/x402 code and a guarded deployment workflow are present, but account-level deployment and production payment settlement remain UNVERIFIED until the required Cloudflare secrets and recipient are independently verified.
